notes: Watering intervals are starting estimates, not fixed schedules.
Air-purifying describes findings in controlled experiments; houseplants do not replace ventilation or filtration in homes.
Pet-friendly means non-toxic to cats and dogs for the named species; eating any plant may still cause stomach upset.
Generated botanical and symptom images are illustrative and should not be used to identify a disease.
